02 / Rehearse your decision

Can I afford to take time to care?

Transparent scenario engine

Accessible savings over time

USD · month from today
● Break now● Part-time● Prepare 6 months--- Emergency floor
Assumptions and model limitations

Cash changes monthly by take-home income minus living expenses and, during the break, care costs. Part-time retains 50% of income and employee retirement contributions. Prepare delays the break by six months, saving the normal surplus first. Emergency floor equals selected months of living plus care expenses. Retirement contribution gaps are shown separately; they are not deducted again from take-home pay. No investment returns, taxes, inflation, employer match, benefits changes or penalties are modeled. Negative balances indicate an unfunded gap, not available credit. Scenario end dates differ; compare common months on the chart. Outputs are illustrative, not validated financial planning.
